ios.desc:
Vanta is a private Markdown notes app for iPhone with AI that runs entirely on your phone, and real GTD built in. Your notes stay as plain Markdown you own. Start with a local vault in seconds: no account, no servers, nothing uploaded.

ON-DEVICE AI
• Turn a messy, rambled note into clean Markdown
• "Clarify with AI" sorts your whole GTD inbox into Next Actions, Waiting For, Someday, Done, or Trash
• Clean up dictation, summarize, and suggest tags
• Powered by Apple's on-device models, so it works offline and nothing ever leaves your phone

GETTING THINGS DONE, BUILT IN
• Capture to your Inbox in a tap, by typing or voice, even from the Share Sheet
• Process your inbox to zero, by hand or with AI
• Next Actions by @context, plus Waiting For, Someday, and Projects
• A weekly review that surfaces stalled projects and what you're waiting on
• Inbox and Next Actions pinned to the top of your vault

A REAL MARKDOWN NOTES APP
• Folders, favorites, and instant full-text search, all offline
• Syntax-highlighted code, callouts, tables, images, SVG, and tasks
• Tap [[wikilinks]] to jump between notes, and see backlinks
• Light and true-black dark themes

YOURS, EVERYWHERE
• Start on-device with no account
• Sync across your devices with iCloud, or your own private GitHub repo
• Obsidian-compatible: open the same vault on your Mac, and favorites sync with Obsidian bookmarks
• No subscription. No analytics. No tracking.

Vanta works great as a standalone local notes app, and plugs into your existing Obsidian or Markdown vault whenever you want.

On-device AI features require an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence.

quotes.text:
Vanta is a Markdown notes app for iPhone, built around on-device AI organization and GTD (Getting Things Done).

I use Obsidian with Claude on desktop, and wanted a similar but automated flow on mobile. This started out as an experiment with Apple's local Foundation models which turned out to be genuinely useful for me. The local models are used to clean up messy dictation, format Markdown, and categorize your inbox using GTD principles.

Maybe one day it'll do your todos for you too :)

Import and sync your existing Obsidian vault on Github, or start with a new one. iCloud Drive sync is included.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777781490
